Category: IT Service Desk

Title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Issues
Category: Account Access

If MFA codes are consistently rejected even though they are entered correctly, the most common cause is clock drift between your phone and the authentication server. The authenticator app allows a time-drift tolerance of up to 30 seconds; if your device clock has drifted beyond that window, codes will fail. Enable "Set time automatically" in your phone's date and time settings to correct this. If you have lost your MFA device entirely, contact the IT helpdesk to have MFA temporarily reset after identity verification through your manager.

Title: VPN Randomly Disconnects
Category: Network Access

Frequent VPN disconnects are often caused by switching between WiFi networks, laptop sleep/wake cycles, or an unstable home internet connection. Disable "Sleep on lid close" while connected to VPN for long sessions, and prefer a wired connection when performing large file transfers. If disconnects happen at a consistent time, check for a scheduled network adapter power-saving setting under Device Manager > Network Adapters > Power Management, and disable "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power." Persistent disconnects lasting more than a day should be reported to IT with the approximate disconnect time.

Category: Software

To set up VPN access on a company laptop, install the GlobalProtect client from the internal software portal. Launch the client and enter the gateway address vpn.company.local. Title: VPN Randomly Disconnects

If Outlook stops syncing new emails, first check your internet connection and confirm the account shows as "Connected" in the bottom status bar. Try File > Account Settings > Repair to let Outlook attempt an automatic repair. On mobile devices, removing and re-adding the corporate email profile through the Mail app settings usually resolves sync delays.
